concerns.text: Task T006g is marked as missing/unverifiable (comment: 'FAILED: unspecified'). FR-004 and US-3 explicitly require 'human-verified reference descriptions' as the gold standard for Fidelity calculation. Without this task being defined and executable, the downstream fidelity analysis (T027, T030) cannot satisfy the spec's acceptance criteria. This is a dropped acceptance criterion.

Task T015 (run_scoring.py) is marked as missing. FR-001 requires the system to compute a Syntactic Complexity Score for *every* input prompt. The absence of the orchestration script to process the full dataset means the primary deliverable of US-1 is incomplete, violating the requirement to produce a complete scoring artifact.

Tasks T001 (project structure) and T003 (linting) are marked as missing. The Plan.md and Constitution Principle I (Reproducibility) mandate a specific project structure and code quality tools. Failing to implement these foundational tasks violates the constitutional requirement for a reproducible, version-controlled environment before user story work begins.

Task T024e specifies generating baseline images for a '[deferred] sample' of the full dataset. FR-004 and US-3 require computing Context Fidelity for 'all generated images' to identify the knee point across the *entire* complexity range. Limiting the baseline to a sample without explicit statistical justification in the spec creates a semantic weakening of the requirement to measure fidelity across the full distribution.

Task T032 includes a conditional branch to 'exclude global regression' if domains differ significantly. While this aligns with Constitution Principle VII, the task description fails to define the required output artifact for this fallback case (e.g., a specific JSON schema for domain-specific thresholds). This creates ambiguity in the deliverable structure, risking a failure to meet the 'Single Source of Truth' principle if the output format is undefined.
